description: Schedules a post to one or more accounts at publish_at, or publishes immediately with publish_now=true. This publishes to real accounts. Times are ISO 8601 ending in Z or an offset, like 2026-11-03T09:00:00+05:30: use the user's own local time with its offset. workspace.timezone from get_context is the workspace's display zone, not necessarily where the user is; if you are unsure of their timezone, ask them. Facebook text post with a link: also set platform_settings.facebook.link (see that field) so Facebook shows a preview card. One call does it all: without post_id it creates the post from the content and settings given and schedules it; with post_id it schedules that draft, applying any fields sent first. type story is an Instagram or Facebook Story: each image or video becomes its own Story, published in file order (up to 10 files), no caption on Instagram. With the post_id of a post that is already scheduled and publish_now=true, it publishes that post now instead of at its time, after the same checks a post published now faces: a refused check leaves it scheduled as it was, and a post under 10 minutes from its time is refused. To change a scheduled post's content or time, use update_post. It takes everything the composer can set: caption, title, media, accounts, per-account text (account_overrides, channel_overrides), per-account media and covers, per-account times, and each platform's settings. With post_id, the per-account maps change only the accounts they name, as in update_post: every other account keeps what the draft has. account_ids is the complete list: an account left out is removed. Each platform setting says whether it is required, an account default or optional; a Pinterest account needs pinterest.board_id, from list_options. Every problem on every account is refused in one error, before anything is armed. Use this only after the user has confirmed the content, the accounts and the time. A refused call writes nothing: no draft is created and no draft is changed. Pass the same idempotency_key on a retry without post_id so a network error never makes two posts; with post_id a retry is safe as is: a post already publishing or published answers its current statuses and is never published twice. Returns success, post_id and results[] with one row per account (platform, username, status, error), plus xLinks when the main post text an X account sends has a link (a link only in a comment or reply returns nothing extra): a note with the link posts on X left this month, or a warning that this post goes out to X without the link. Pass its text on to the user. Call get_post afterwards to show exactly what was scheduled. Does NOT publish now unless publish_now is true.

account_ids.description: Where this post goes: each account's ref from list_accounts (e.g. "x:acme_studio"), or its id. Prefer the ref; it is what the person reads when approving. Always the complete list, unlike the per-account maps: an account left out is removed from the post, with its text and settings.

description.description: This account's caption. "" posts no text on this account, but a text post still needs content there: media, or on some platforms post hashtags, a title or a link. An empty text post is refused with "Write a caption before publishing".

account_overrides.description: Text for one account, keyed by account ref or id: title, caption, hashtags. Send only the accounts you are changing; every other account keeps its text. An entry is that account's whole text (a field it leaves out is cleared); null clears the account's text. Wins over channel_overrides and the base text.

actor.description: Another account of the same platform that writes this comment (ref or id), replying to the post itself. Omit for the account's own comment, which replies to the one above it. X and Bluesky.

delay_minutes.description: Minutes to wait after the comment above went out (the post, for the first one, or for another account's comment), 0 to 1440.

actor.description: The account that reposts the post (ref or id): the posting account itself or another account of the same platform. X, Bluesky and Threads.

delay_minutes.description: Minutes to wait after the post went out, 0 to 1440.

actor.description: The account that quotes the post (ref or id): the posting account itself or another account of the same platform. Bluesky and Threads; X accounts repost only.

delay_minutes.description: Minutes to wait after the post went out, 0 to 1440.

text.description: What the quoting account says above the quoted post.

actions_by_account.description: What happens once the post is live, keyed by the account it goes out on (ref or id): that account's whole ordered list. Its own comments (no actor) each reply to the one above after their delay (X and Bluesky). A comment with an actor is written by that other account of the same platform; a repost or quote is done by its actor, the posting account itself or another account of the same platform. Both count their delay from the post (comments X and Bluesky; reposts X, Bluesky and Threads; quotes Bluesky and Threads, never X). At most 10 per account; [] removes them. Send only the accounts you are changing; every other account keeps its actions. An account that has already published keeps its actions as they are.

alt_text.description: [optional] One description per file, in the order this account publishes its media; "" leaves a file undescribed. Either exactly as many entries as files, or none. Up to 2000 characters each. Sending Bluesky settings replaces the stored ones whole, so leaving this out stores no alt text. Default [].

labels.description: [optional] Content warnings: at most one of sexual (Suggestive), nudity, porn (Adult), plus graphic-media. On text posts and posts with images or video. Sending Bluesky settings replaces the stored ones whole, so leaving this out stores no labels. Default [].

langs.description: [optional] The post's languages as BCP 47 codes (e.g. "en", "pt-BR"), at most 3. Bluesky uses them for language feeds. Default: none, Bluesky guesses.

bluesky.description: bluesky settings keyed by bluesky account (ref or id). Each field says whether it is required, an account default or optional. Send only the accounts you are changing: an entry is that account's whole settings, and every other account keeps its own.

description.description: This account's caption. "" posts no text on this account, but a text post still needs content there: media, or on some platforms post hashtags, a title or a link. An empty text post is refused with "Write a caption before publishing".

channel_overrides.description: Text for every account of one platform, keyed by platform id (e.g. "instagram"): "the Instagram caption". Send only the platforms you are changing; null clears the text of that platform's accounts. An account_overrides entry for the same account wins field by field.

cover_by_account.description: One account's own video cover, keyed by account ref or id: a media_key, or null to use the post's cover.

cover_key.description: media_key of a cover image for video posts.

cover_timestamp_ms.description: The video frame, in milliseconds, used as the cover when no cover image is set.

feeling.description: [optional] The Page's feeling or activity shown beside its name. activity feeling with feeling a name from the list, e.g. { activity: "feeling", feeling: "happy" } shows "is feeling happy"; any other activity with text, up to 100 characters, e.g. { activity: "playing", text: "Minecraft" } shows "is playing Minecraft". On text and photo posts only; refused on a video, Reel or Story. Default none.

link.description: [optional] A web address Facebook shows as a preview card under a text post. When a Facebook text post's caption has one link, set it here too so the card shows; with several links, ask the user which one. Ignored on a post with images or video. A link only in the caption shows as plain text. Default none.

made_with_ai.description: [optional] Label the post as made with AI ("AI info" on Facebook). On text posts, photo posts and Reels (video_as reel); refused on a classic Page video and on a Story. Default false.

video_as.description: [optional] Publish a video as a Reel: 3 to 90 seconds, vertical 9:16, at most 30 Reels per Page per day. Default: a classic Page video.

facebook.description: facebook settings keyed by facebook account (ref or id). Each field says whether it is required, an account default or optional. Send only the accounts you are changing: an entry is that account's whole settings, and every other account keeps its own.

call_to_action.description: [optional] A button on the post: BOOK, ORDER, SHOP, LEARN_MORE or SIGN_UP with a url, or CALL with no url (it rings the business phone). Ignored on OFFER: Google shows no button on an offer. Default none.

event.description: [optional] Required for EVENT and OFFER. Dates YYYY-MM-DD, times HH:MM 24-hour in the business's own time; give both times or neither (no time shows as all day). Default none.

language_code.description: [optional] Language of the post text: a two-letter code such as "en", "ta", "es" (or "fil"), optionally with an uppercase two-letter region such as "en-US" or "pt-BR". Default "en".

offer.description: [optional] OFFER only: coupon code, redeem link and terms, each optional. Default none.

topic_type.description: [optional] STANDARD is an update, EVENT an event, OFFER an offer. EVENT and OFFER need event. Default STANDARD.

gbp.description: gbp settings keyed by gbp account (ref or id). Each field says whether it is required, an account default or optional. Send only the accounts you are changing: an entry is that account's whole settings, and every other account keeps its own.

idempotency_key.description: Without post_id: any unique string; a retry with the same key never makes a second post.

trial_reel.description: [optional] Share a Reel as a Trial Reel, to non-followers first. manual: you decide whether it goes to followers; auto: Instagram decides on performance. Reels with one video only. Default: a normal Reel.

instagram.description: instagram settings keyed by instagram account (ref or id). Each field says whether it is required, an account default or optional. Send only the accounts you are changing: an entry is that account's whole settings, and every other account keeps its own.

carousel_name.description: [optional] The document title LinkedIn shows on the carousel. Used only with post_as_images_carousel. Default "slides".

post_as_images_carousel.description: [optional] Post the images as one swipeable document (a carousel, one page per image) instead of an image grid. Needs 2 to 20 images and no video; a GIF shows its first frame. Default false.

linkedin.description: linkedin settings keyed by linkedin account (ref or id). Each field says whether it is required, an account default or optional. Send only the accounts you are changing: an entry is that account's whole settings, and every other account keeps its own.

media_by_account.description: One account's own media, keyed by account ref or id. A non-empty list of media_key values is that account's whole ordered media, posted instead of the post's media; null resets the account to the post's media. An account left out takes the post's media on create and keeps its media unchanged on update.

media_urls.description: Without post_id: public http(s) URLs of the ORIGINAL files to download and attach, up to 100 MB each.

alt_text.description: [optional] Describes the image for screen readers. Default none; the title is never used.

board_id.description: [account default] The board the Pin goes on. Default: the account's saved board, and no account has one yet, so every Pin needs this: ask the user which board, from list_options req_type list_board.

link.description: [optional] The Pin's clickable destination. A URL in the caption is never clickable on Pinterest. Default none.

pinterest.description: pinterest settings keyed by pinterest account (ref or id). Each field says whether it is required, an account default or optional. Send only the accounts you are changing: an entry is that account's whole settings, and every other account keeps its own.

post_id.description: A draft from create_post or list_posts, or a scheduled post to publish now with publish_now. Leave out to create the post in this call.

publish_at.description: ISO 8601 with Z or an offset, in the user's own local time, like 2026-11-03T09:00:00+05:30. At least 10 minutes ahead. Either this or publish_now.

publish_at_overrides.description: A different publish time for one account, keyed by account ref or id (ISO 8601 with Z or an offset, as publish_at).

publish_now.description: true to publish immediately, a scheduled post included. Either this or publish_at.

ai_generated.description: [optional] Label the post as AI-generated, on photo and video posts. Set it when the photos or the video were made or significantly edited with AI. TikTok does not let the label be removed after posting. Default false.

auto_add_music.description: [optional] Let TikTok add its recommended music to a photo post. Photo posts only; ignored on a video. On a photo post it wins over music: the track is not sent. Default false.

brand_content.description: [optional] Branded content for someone else. Needs commercial_content; cannot be SELF_ONLY. Default false.

brand_organic.description: [optional] Promotes the creator's own brand. Needs commercial_content. Default false.

commercial_content.description: [optional] The post promotes a brand, product or service. Default false.

delivery.description: [optional] direct_post publishes the post to the account; it is the only value. Default direct_post.

interactions.description: [account default] Allow comments, duets and stitches on this post. Default: the switches saved on the account. Anything the creator turned off in TikTok stays off. Send only when the user asks.

location.description: [optional] A place tagged on the post, as { id, name } from list_options req_type list_location with a query. TikTok Business accounts only (list_accounts shows api "business"); refused on a personal account. Default none.

music.description: [optional] A track from TikTok's commercial music library on a video or photo post, as { id, name } from list_options req_type list_music. On a video, audio_volume is the track's volume and video_volume the original sound's, each 0-100 (0 mutes), default 50; a photo post ignores both. TikTok Business accounts only; refused on a personal account. On a photo post with auto_add_music on, the track is not sent. Default none.

privacy_level.description: [optional] Who can see the post. SELF_ONLY when the user says "only me". Default PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE.

tiktok.description: tiktok settings keyed by tiktok account (ref or id). Each field says whether it is required, an account default or optional. Send only the accounts you are changing: an entry is that account's whole settings, and every other account keeps its own.

title.description: Title, used by platforms that have one (YouTube, Pinterest). Required for a blog post, where it becomes the WordPress page heading.

link_url.description: [optional] A link Tumblr shows as a card on the post. A link in the caption stays plain text. Default none. Tags go in account_overrides hashtags.

source_url.description: [optional] The post's Source credit. Default none.

tumblr.description: tumblr settings keyed by tumblr account (ref or id). Each field says whether it is required, an account default or optional. Send only the accounts you are changing: an entry is that account's whole settings, and every other account keeps its own.

type.description: Required without post_id: the type the user asked for. Ask if they have not said. story is an Instagram or Facebook Story: one Story per file, in order, up to 10. blog is a WordPress blog post.

categories.description: [optional] Category names that already exist on the site; an unknown one is refused at schedule with the site's list. Only for a post type that has categories. Default: the site's default category.

excerpt.description: [optional] Short summary for feeds and link previews. Default: WordPress makes one from the body.

featured_image_alt.description: [optional] Alt text for the featured image (the first image). Default none.

post_type.description: [optional] The post type to publish as, e.g. a short story instead of a blog post: a slug from list_options req_type list_post_type. Default post.

seo.description: [optional] Yoast SEO fields. Only for an account whose list_accounts entry shows seo "yoast". Default: Yoast's own.

slug.description: [optional] The URL slug. Default: made from the title.

status.description: [optional] publish; draft or pending (Pending review) to review it in wp-admin; private for logged-in editors only. Default publish.

tags.description: [optional] Tag names; a new one is created. Only for a post type that has tags. Default none.

terms.description: [optional] Terms of the post type's own taxonomies, as { taxonomy slug: [names] }, e.g. { "genre": ["Romance"] }. list_post_type names each type's taxonomies. Names must already exist on the site; an unknown one is refused at schedule with the site's list. Default none.

wordpress.description: wordpress settings keyed by wordpress account (ref or id). Each field says whether it is required, an account default or optional. Send only the accounts you are changing: an entry is that account's whole settings, and every other account keeps its own.

made_with_ai.description: [optional] Label the post as made with AI. Default false.

paid_partnership.description: [optional] Label the post as a paid partnership. Default false.

reply_settings.description: [optional] Who can reply: everyone, following (accounts you follow), mentionedUsers, verified or subscribers. Default everyone.

x.description: x settings keyed by x account (ref or id). Each field says whether it is required, an account default or optional. Send only the accounts you are changing: an entry is that account's whole settings, and every other account keeps its own.

category_id.description: [optional] YouTube category id, e.g. "22" People & Blogs, "27" Education, "28" Science & Technology. Default "22". Tags go in account_overrides hashtags, 500 characters in all.

made_for_kids.description: [optional] Made for kids. YouTube turns off comments and personalised ads when true. Default false.

privacy_status.description: [optional] Who can watch: public, unlisted (anyone with the link) or private. Default public.

youtube.description: youtube settings keyed by youtube account (ref or id). Each field says whether it is required, an account default or optional. Send only the accounts you are changing: an entry is that account's whole settings, and every other account keeps its own.

name: schedule_post

xLinks.description: Only when the main post text an X account sends has a link; a link only in a comment (reply) returns nothing, since replies with links don't count. Links count when the post publishes; past the allowance they are removed and the rest posts. Scheduling is never refused for links.

allowance.description: Link posts on X this month: the plan's plus each link pack for X.

level.description: warning: this post goes over the month's allowance of link posts on X, so some of its X posts go out without the link.

linkPosts.description: This post's X accounts whose main post text has a link; each one uses one.

scheduled.description: Other X posts with a link waiting to publish this month.

text.description: The sentence to pass on to the user.

used.description: X posts sent with their link since the monthly step began.

title: Schedule a post
